# M10-19: the Butcher held by the hero (the stick mashed left and right: the hero's own hold, Mustapha's too) and the kick after a wall jump (Mustapha, Hannah). The escape
# of a hero that an enemy holds has no recipe: the thug of class 10 never grabs (the 0x400 bias at 0x3C74A), a Rock Hopper did not close in, the Butcher does not take
# the hero here; the natural runs hold the hero (Zeke's dive grab) and are equal.
